notes.title: V1.0.4 UPDATE
notes.content:
Ahoy, Bean Blasters! 

I hope your boat hasn't been capsized by the waves ~ In this update, we’ve implemented several bug fixes and optimizations. Please see the full details below.

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] The unlock condition for the character [Fruitie] has been changed from [Eat 100 Heart Fruits in total] to [Eat 50 Heart Fruits in total].
[*] The unlock condition for the character [Angel] has been changed from [Clear any stages using 5 different characters] to [Clear any stages using 3 different characters].
[*] Slightly increased the initial range, spread, and combo bonus amplification of the weapon [Shotgun].
[*] The item [Shiny Heart Bottle] now restores all HP upon increasing Max HP, just like the [Heart Bottle].
[*] The game will now attempt to restore any Steam achievements that failed to unlock due to network issues when launching the game, based on the save data.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the sticker [Moneymaker], which can now be obtained under the correct conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the total number of stickers displayed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where controller players couldn't click the [Confirm] button after unlocking the [Cthulhu's Approval] achievement and the hard difficulty stages for the first time.
[*] Fixed an issue where players in a downed state could still automatically regenerate HP in multiplayer mode while [Assist Mode] was enabled.
[*] Fixed an issue where the night effect from Phase 2 of the [Cthulhu] boss fight did not disappear correctly in Phase 3.
[/list]

If you encounter problems at sea, you can find us on the social media, and the rescue ship will set off quickly.

notes.title: Bang Bang Barrage's FAQ!
notes.content:
[p]Ahoy, Bean Blasters! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/79c1dccc4c87346fc3c2f38fc4184cdb3573fdda.png"][/img]Friends near and far, on land or sea—listen up!

Before braving the chaos of [i]Bang Bang Barrage[/i], here’s your [b]Captain’s Handbook[/b]—everything you need to know before launch! 🥁⚓

[b]Q: Where can I play Bang Bang Barrage? [/b]

A: [i]Bang Bang Barrage[/i] is currently available on [b]Steam[/b], and supports both [b]Windows[/b] and [b]Mac[/b] systems.
[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: What’s in the full version, and how is it different from the demo?[/b]

A: The full game unlocks all content previously marked as “Coming Soon” in the demo, including:[/p][list][*][p]✅ 20 playable characters[/p][/*][*][p]✅ 5 weapon types[/p][/*][*][p]✅ 10 full levels[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Cosmetic collectibles & sticker challenges[/p][/*][/list][p]⏱️ [b]First-time clear time:[/b] Around [b]10 hours[/b] depending on your skill and whether you're playing solo or with a squad.[/p][p]But don’t worry—it doesn’t end there!
[i]Bang Bang Barrage[/i] is a [b]roguelike[/b], meaning every run is different. Characters, weapons, and enemy waves combine in endlessly wild ways. Each combo unlocks new strategies, and collectible skins/sticker challenges add tons of replay value.
[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: Can I play with friends? How many players does it support?[/b]
A：Absolutely! [i]Bang Bang Barrage[/i] supports [b]1–4 players[/b], both:[/p][list][*][p][b]Local co-op[/b] (same device)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Online multiplayer[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]In the main menu, choose [b]\[Local Co-Op][/b] or [b]\[Online Mode][/b]. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/6d51fb68b692f4beebf33605279c6737ea0f63e8.png"][/img]
If you want to play with non-Steam friends, you need to check \[Use Room Code] and send the code to the other party. After the other party uses the room code to join the room, you can play together. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/74fd1054b9cb1ff62999bc9653bd00787e815325.png"][/img]
After the host checks \[Use Room Code], you can find the room code at the top of the interface when entering the room. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/7b4d6b44cdcece6130a7824b3c4e749336a275bc.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: How many copies are needed for multiplayer play?[/b]

A: 
[b]Local multiplayer:[/b] Only [b]1 copy[/b] is needed for up to 4 players
(⚠️ Note: Only one player can use a mouse. The rest will need controllers!)[/p][list][*][p][b]Online multiplayer:[/b] Each player needs their own copy[/p][/*][*][p]You can also [b]combine both[/b]: e.g., 2 players on one PC + 2 friends online!
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: Can we still play together if our save progress doesn’t match?[/b]

A: Yes! You can always join each other online.
The levels you can choose depend on the [b]host’s progress[/b].[/p][p]📌 Example:
If Player A is on Level 1-4 and Player B is only on Level 1-1, Player A can host and both can jump into Level 1-4 together. Once completed, [b]both will unlock Level 1-5[/b]![/p][p]We still recommend starting from the beginning for the smoothest experience—but it’s totally up to you.
[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: [/b]Do coins from the demo carry over?

A: Unfortunately, the coins in the Demo cannot be carried over to the full version.

Unfortunately, demo coins [b]won’t carry over[/b]. But!
In the full version:[/p][list][*][p]Characters and weapons are [b]unlocked via gameplay[/b] (not coins)[/p][/*][*][p]Coins are used for [b]skins and cosmetic items[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Tons of coins can be earned through the sticker challenge system—so don’t worry about running out!
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: What about the skins from the demo?[/b]  

A : All demo bonus skins WILL carry over!
This includes:[/p][list][*][p]Christmas Hat Beanie 🎅[/p][/*][*][p]Heart Beanie 💖[/p][/*][*][p]Pumpkin Boat 🎃[/p][/*][*][p]Snake Boat 🐍[/p][/*][/list][p]And don’t worry—there are [b]plenty of new skins[/b] to unlock in the full game, too!
[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: Is there an easier mode for casual players or kids?[/b]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/50224e50c00f049adb2c70ff619a1fe94bac4d82.png"][/img] A: Yes! If you’re new to shooters, or playing with kids, try [b]Assist Mode[/b] in the settings. It makes the game more forgiving while keeping the fun.[/p][p]We encourage players to turn it off once they feel comfortable for the full roguelike experience![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: Can I fight Cthulhu like in the opening animation?[/b]

Oh yes.
You’ll face off against the tentacled terror himself in:[/p][list][*][p][b]Stage 1-5: R’lyeh[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Stage 2-5: Dreamworld R’lyeh[/b]
Good luck. You’ll need it.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Q: Can I play solo?[/b]  

A : Definitely. The game is [b]fully solo-playable[/b] with access to all:[/p][list][*][p]Characters[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Levels[/p][/*][*][p]Steam achievements[/p][/*][/list][p]But with friends? Things get [b]way more chaotic and fun[/b].
We support only invite-based online play (no random matchmaking) to ensure the best co-op experience.
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3][b]Join the chaos and help spread the word![/b][/h3][p]👉 [b]Follow us for updates, sneak peeks, and surprises.[/b][/p][p]And if you haven’t already—[b]wishlist the game on Steam[/b] to stay notified when it launches![/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://x.com/bangbangbarrage"]Twitter[/url] | [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@bangbangbarrage"]Tiktok[/url][/p]

notes.title: New Survival Multiplayer Shooter Game Looking for Playtesters!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/668fa2cae2f86bcfb49b29f5647a487d8165b135.png[/img]

Greetings Bean Blasters,

Welcome! We’re the creators of Bang Bang Barrage, an upcoming sea-themed roguelite survival multiplayer shooter game. Today, we're bubbling with excitement to share that our first ever global playtest is now live on Steam, and we'd like to invite you to try the game out! Get ready to dive into the treacherous sea with a quirky twist that’ll keep you coming back for more.

[b][h2]Click below to play the game 👇[/h2][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003460/Bang_Bang_Barrage/

[b][h3]Watch Our Latest Trailer:[/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=MXKPm2Xp06c;full] https://youtu.be/MXKPm2Xp06c [/previewyoutube]

[b][h3]About the Game[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/62f5caf19386727b562d2954be7f84ebef8a64c7.png[/img]
In Bang Bang Barrage, you play as an adorable, gun-wielding bean fighting to survive the perils of Cthulhu in the treacherous sea. In order to do so, you must master a unique recoil-based movement system where every shot counts, turning your gunplay into a dance of strategy. Play solo or team up with friends, and experience fresh adventures with endless combinations of upgrades and dynamic game conditions. Ready, aim, and blast your way to victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/b76ebe02ea84a4464738e2f96b4a8a8808ee149b.gif[/img]
[b]Recoil-Driven Navigation[/b]: Propel yourself through the waters with each shot! Turn gunplay into a dance of strategy and precision. Master the art of movement to outmaneuver and outlast the sea’s dangers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/01d6bb51e08c5a65e6c71c7ed5543e6616c4aaea.gif[/img]
[b]Multiplayer Mayhem[/b]: Sail solo or with up to three friends, mastering the waves through seamless teamwork or solo cunning. More players, more chaos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/717bcef213e312eff3a88421118394d144f7f7c4.gif[/img]
[b]Endless Replayability[/b]: Each voyage across the sea is unique, with fresh challenges, traits, and upgrade paths to explore. No two games are the same, ensuring endless fun and discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139977/2f3d718ba48ad2a308a47848f431a4ee1ceef4f7.gif[/img]
[b]Ever-Changing Voyages[/b]: Tailor each run with a variety of upgrades and adapt to spontaneous buffs and debuffs that the sea throws at you. Adapt your strategy on the fly and make the most out of unexpected twists and turns.

We're especially excited for you to try out our game, which currently supports up to 2 players local co-op. Through this playtest, we hope to gather your feedback to help us improve the game, and we're eager to hear what you think about it! Please share with us through this [url=https://forms.gle/oxuF41gqu8VJj95R8]feedback form[/url], and if you encounter any issues, don't hesitate to reach out on our Steam discussion page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003460/Bang_Bang_Barrage/

If you enjoy the game, please wishlist us on Steam! Every bit of support counts, and we’d be over the moon (or should we say, over the sea?) if you could help spread the word and share the game with your friends too.

Last but not the least, be sure to follow us on our social media pages for more updates and sneak peeks. Thank you for coming along with us for the journey, and we hope you have fun playtesting our game! 😊
